title: Mutual Wanting in Human–AI Interaction: Empirical Evidence from Large-Scale Analysis of GPT Model Transitions

contributions.purpose: 实证验证人-AI 双向期待(“mutual wanting”)
contributions.mechanism: 分析 22,411 条论坛评论 + 729 条 API 探测响应
contributions.evaluation: 拟人化语言占 48.65%,信任:背叛=11.9:1,期待违背 2.23%
contributions.source_quote: analysis of over 22,000 user comments and hundreds of controlled API probe responses across multiple OpenAI models

contributions.purpose: 提出互相想要提取方法学
contributions.mechanism: 自定义词典 + 双算法主题建模(LDA+NMF)+ 多维特征工程
contributions.evaluation: K-means 聚类识别用户类型(silhouette=0.304)
contributions.source_quote: a comprehensive mutual wanting extraction pipeline using custom lexicons, dual-algorithm topic modeling, and multi-dimensional feature engineering

contributions.purpose: 构建 M-WAF 理论框架
contributions.mechanism: 经验维度化用户欲望与系统隐性欲望
contributions.source_quote: the Mutual Wanting Alignment Framework (M-WAF) with empirically validated dimensions

contributions.evaluation: 报告 11 个类型(C0-C10),但文中又称 optimal K=10,自相矛盾;Creativity-seeking 占 43.14%
contributions.source_quote: identification of distinct user types based on mutual wanting patterns

contributions.mechanism: 期待违背检测 / 信任校准监控 / 拟人化感知设计
contributions.source_quote: measurable approaches for expectation violation detection, trust calibration monitoring, and anthropomorphism-aware design

notes: 5 条自声明贡献(intro 编号列表)。数据红旗:(1)称 GPT-5 于 “December 2024” 发布,时间线为杜撰(GPT-5 实际 2025 年发布);(2)聚类数自相矛盾——正文/结论称 11 个用户类型,方法处又称 optimal K=10;(3)API 探测中 gpt-5/gpt-5-mini 平均响应长度仅 8/45 字符、warmth/formality 全 0,明显是探测调用被截断/失败,却被当作“objective validation of personality change” 解读。负结果/trade-off:承认单一 Reddit 语料、单次模型迁移、无跨平台验证。四元组适配尚可但实证质量低,desk-reject 级。
